_meta.how_to_regress: npm run check:golden focus-pocus  (dev backend up)
_meta.note: Rewritten 2026-08-26 as a bounded-session tool. The v1 sample is gone with the v1 tool: escalating alarms, snooze counts, break plans and /patterns no longer exist. Two routes now — POST /api/focus-pocus for the three actions that call the model (prepare, stuck, review) and POST /api/focus-pocus/session for timer state, which sits in the AUTOMATIC rate-limit bucket because the default 12/minute would kill a session that syncs. Sessions are held in memory with a 6h TTL and rehydrate from the client copy after a deploy, so a restart between capture and check is normal and not a regression. The start case is byte-stable; the three model cases vary and are read, not asserted.
